cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml') and ('document' in n or 'header' in n or 'footer' in n):
        data=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        # strip tags to see text
        txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',data)
        placeholders=set(re.findall(r'[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,}',txt))
        if placeholders:
            print(f"=== {n} ===")
            print(sorted(placeholders))
EOF

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
PARA=re.compile(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',re.S)
def texts(n):
    d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
    for p in PARA.findall(d):
        t=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',p,re.S))
        if t.strip(): print(f"  {t!r}")
print("=== document.xml ===")
texts('word/document.xml')
for n in ['word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml','word/header2.xml','word/header4.xml']:
    print(f"=== {n} ===")
    texts(n)
# leftover check across all
print("\n=== leftover placeholders ===")
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        merged=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',d,re.S))
        left=re.findall(r'\{\{[A-Z_0-9]+\}\}',merged)
        if left: print(n,left)
print("done")
EOF
